reuse.why: Uses the tree's isSkippedWeekendOccurrence and getDateWithSkippedWeekend(date, config) exactly as getUpcomingDates does, plus the months.ts addDays/subDays/parseDate helpers.

duplication.why: No weekend logic is restated; only the short occurrences -> filter(skip) -> map(shift) pipeline and try/captureBreadcrumb scaffolding mirror getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: New handler in server/schedules/app.ts beside schedule/get-upcoming-dates, registered the same way; rules stay in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: A short declarative pipeline whose weekend semantics come entirely from the shared helpers, so a rule change propagates automatically; the 2-day pad is commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend skipping and shifting go through the shared WeekendRule helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the new consumer calls the shared helpers instead of restating them.
